items.title: Pete Candoli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 15, 1999
items.q: I used to work out all the time in Sid Klein’s gym in New York

ctx.x: In all the playing you’ve done, did you ever have any physical problems that kind of put a crimp in your activities for a while?

Only one time with Woody’s band. I had a scotty that used to travel with me all the time, my little scotty. And one night I came home from the Sherman Hotel and the little scotty was asleep on the bed and I guess I awakened it and it snapped unconsciously, and bit me right on the lip. So of course it bled and swelled up a little bit, but I said well I’d better cool it and bask in the sun at least for a few days or something, which we did. But they wrote a big deal about it, like “bitten on the lip by such and…
You probably could have won the body building contest, at least within the musician community.
